title: Milestones & evidence
summary: Give projects tasks, deadlines, completion rules, and linked evidence from your practice journal.
outcome: A project detail page whose progress reflects verified milestone state and stays consistent after edits.
prerequisites: Finish Project tracker. Read src/db/repos/practiceRepo.ts and its tests.
model: Milestone: id, projectId, title, dueDate (optional YYYY-MM-DD), order, status, evidenceMissionId (optional).
One project has many milestones. Define what happens to children when a project is archived or removed.
Treat a deadline as a calendar date unless the product explicitly requires an instant and time zone.
boundaries: Project detail → milestone service → project and milestone repositories. Keep changes that must succeed together inside one database transaction.

milestones.title: Add related tasks and deadlines
milestones.brief: Create and reorder milestones inside a project, with a clear due-date policy.
milestones.explanation: A projectId string is not proof that the parent exists. Validate the relationship at the write boundary and use database guarantees where available. Compose small services so the screen does not have to orchestrate parent lookup, validation, and child insertion itself.
steps: Define create, rename, reorder, and remove behavior with examples for a missing or archived parent.
Implement the operations and a project detail screen with labeled controls. Reject impossible dates and document whether past deadlines are allowed.
Persist ordering explicitly. Test a fresh load with multiple projects so milestones cannot leak into another project's list.

checks.label: Each milestone appears only under its own project.
Missing parents and invalid dates are rejected before a child is saved.
Reordering and deletion persist after reload.

milestones.experiment: Attempt to create a milestone using a project ID that was just removed. Inspect the store for orphan records.
milestones.review: Explain the parent-child invariant and where it is enforced. Use deterministic ordering when two rows share the same position.
milestones.stretch: Add due-today and overdue filters and test them near midnight in two time zones.

milestones.title: Link completion to evidence
milestones.brief: Require an outcome, verification, and tradeoff before marking a milestone complete.
milestones.explanation: Completion is a business transition, not just a checkbox. Validate evidence when the transition occurs. Link to stable journal IDs instead of copying text into multiple places, and define how missing or reopened evidence affects milestone status.
steps: Choose and document whether reopening a linked journal entry reopens its milestone or leaves a historical completion snapshot.
Add a link to a practice entry and show its outcome, verification, and tradeoff. Gate completion at the service boundary.
Implement reopening and progress counts derived from stored milestones. Include empty projects and removed evidence in the cases.

checks.label: Incomplete evidence cannot mark a milestone complete through UI or direct service calls.
A completed milestone can be reopened and its progress count updates.
Missing evidence is visible and does not crash the detail page.

milestones.experiment: Complete one of three milestones, reopen its evidence, then reload. Compare the result with your documented rule.
milestones.review: Avoid maintaining a separate completedCount that can drift from the underlying milestones. State what self-reviewed completion does and does not establish.
milestones.stretch: Export a project work-sample report with milestone evidence and links to commits.

milestones.title: Make multi-record edits atomic
milestones.brief: Prevent half-completed project changes when a child write fails.
milestones.explanation: Sequential Effect steps do not automatically form a database transaction. Atomicity comes from the storage transaction that encloses the related writes. Do not hold a transaction open while waiting for a network request or user interaction.
steps: Choose a multi-row operation, such as moving milestones between projects or archiving a project and its active children. Write the invariant before coding.
Implement a repository operation that owns the transaction. Inject a failure after the first write and inspect every affected row.
Use the same failure case through the UI. Preserve selection and drafts so the user can retry after rollback.

checks.label: All related writes commit together on success.
An injected intermediate failure leaves every affected row unchanged.
Retry after rollback yields the same final state as one successful attempt.

milestones.experiment: Fail the second of three writes. A test that only checks the returned error is insufficient: compare the before and after database snapshots.
milestones.review: Show which transaction covers which rows. Distinguish a storage transaction from Effect error recovery.
milestones.stretch: Introduce two competing edits and define which revision checks must occur inside the transaction.

milestones.title: Model prerequisite relationships
milestones.brief: Let a milestone depend on another milestone while preventing self-dependencies, cycles, and references across unrelated projects.
milestones.explanation: A prerequisite graph is part of your data model. The UI may guide selection, but the service must enforce relationship rules for imports and direct calls too. A dependency added concurrently can invalidate a previous cycle check, so define the transaction or serialization boundary that protects the graph.
steps: Choose whether completion is blocked by unmet prerequisites or merely displays a warning. Define removal and reopening behavior before writing controls.
Implement add/remove dependency commands, cycle detection, and a readable blocked-state explanation. Validate both endpoints belong to the allowed project scope.
Exercise A depends on B, B depends on C, then C depends on A. Test the same cases through import and concurrent commands.

checks.label: Self-links, missing endpoints, and forbidden cross-project links are rejected.
A cycle cannot be committed through any write path.
The interface explains which prerequisite is incomplete and links to it.

milestones.experiment: Have two clients add opposite edges at the same time. Verify that the chosen storage boundary prevents a cycle even if both initial reads were valid.
milestones.review: Explain graph correctness separately from the display ordering. A visually sorted list is not evidence that cycle creation is impossible.
milestones.stretch: Show the earliest actionable milestone without hiding tasks that a learner may intentionally study out of order.

milestones.title: Build trustworthy project summaries
milestones.brief: Display completed, overdue, and blocked milestone counts without letting a cached summary contradict the underlying records.
milestones.explanation: An aggregate has a precise definition. Decide whether archived milestones, missing deadlines, and reopened evidence participate in each count. Derived values can be computed from source records or maintained as projections; projections require update and repair rules. Use one interpretation across the dashboard, project page, and exports.
steps: Write a six-record fixture covering completed, reopened, overdue, undated, archived, and blocked milestones. Calculate expected counts by hand.
Implement the aggregate at a repository or query boundary and consume it from the UI. Avoid one query for every row in a large project list.
Update a deadline and reopen evidence while the dashboard is open. Verify live counts, reload behavior, and an empty project's denominator.

checks.label: Counts agree with the hand-calculated fixture.
Edits and reopening update every displayed summary consistently.
Query count remains bounded as the project list grows.

milestones.experiment: Move the test clock past midnight while the page stays open. Verify overdue status updates under your documented calendar and time-zone policy.
milestones.review: Report the number of database reads as well as the final numbers. Cache invalidation belongs to the feature contract when you choose to cache aggregates.
milestones.stretch: Create a reconciliation command that rebuilds a deliberately corrupted projection from authoritative records.

milestones.title: Turn project mistakes into review material
milestones.brief: Link a concrete debugging lesson to a flashcard and a milestone without confusing recall ratings with engineering completion.
milestones.explanation: A flashcard tests recall; a project journal records performed work. Keeping those meanings separate prevents a successful quiz from falsely completing a build task. Link stable identifiers, preserve source evidence, and let the learner revise an explanation after a second attempt rather than treating the first answer as permanent truth.
steps: Choose one actual project failure and write a narrow recall question about its cause. Include a worked example and a counterexample in the answer.
Add a link from milestone evidence to the card while retaining the journal's outcome and verification. Define what happens if the card is deleted.
Review the card, then repeat a small implementation variation without the agent. Record the difference between remembered explanation and observed coding behavior.

checks.label: Review ratings never silently change milestone completion.
A missing linked card has a recoverable display state.
The work sample includes a reproducible implementation variation.

milestones.experiment: Answer the flashcard correctly, then deliberately omit the transaction from the implementation. Explain why the passing review cannot validate the broken feature.
milestones.review: Keep evidence specific: a test result, commit, and observed behavior are stronger than a confidence score. Ask the agent for a new case after you explain the first one.
milestones.stretch: Export a portfolio entry containing the initial mistake, corrected rule, regression test, and follow-up learning question.

milestones.title: Reject an orphan task
milestones.brief: Create task T-9 against project P-4 after that project disappears.
milestones.explanation: A task may reference only a project that exists at the write boundary.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Create task T-9 against project P-4 after that project disappears. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Validate the parent relationship inside the repository transaction.
Delete P-4 between form load and submission. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: No orphan task appears in the task table.
The UI retains the title and explains the missing parent.
Recovery evidence: Restore a different project using a different ID and retry. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Restore a different project using a different ID and retry.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the command rely solely on a previously loaded dropdown?
milestones.stretch: Offer moving the retained draft to an explicitly selected existing project.

milestones.title: Interpret date-only deadlines
milestones.brief: Set a task deadline to 2030-03-10 while viewing the app in two time zones.
milestones.explanation: A calendar deadline is not an instant until the product assigns a timezone policy.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Set a task deadline to 2030-03-10 while viewing the app in two time zones. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Store the date-only representation and compare calendar dates deliberately.
Render the same record in Los Angeles and Tokyo. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Both users see the intended calendar date.
Parsing never shifts the deadline to the preceding day.
Recovery evidence: Cross midnight using a controlled clock and recompute overdue status. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Cross midnight using a controlled clock and recompute overdue status.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Did the agent introduce UTC conversion for a date-only field?
milestones.stretch: Add project-local deadline zones with explicit migration rules.

milestones.title: Keep task order stable
milestones.brief: Seed three tasks with identical sort ranks and move one between its neighbors.
milestones.explanation: A task order needs a deterministic tie rule and a safe rebalancing strategy.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Seed three tasks with identical sort ranks and move one between its neighbors. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Define rank allocation and an ID tiebreaker before implementing movement.
Move first-to-last, last-to-first, and between equal ranks. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Reload preserves the requested order with unique visible positions.
The moved task never duplicates or disappears during rerender.
Recovery evidence: Interrupt between rank calculation and transactional update. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Interrupt between rank calculation and transactional update.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Can concurrent moves produce order-dependent data loss?
milestones.stretch: Add revision-aware reorder commands with a conflict preview.

milestones.title: Archive a parent with children
milestones.brief: Archive a project containing two open tasks and one completed task.
milestones.explanation: Child visibility and editability must follow an explicit parent-archive policy.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Archive a project containing two open tasks and one completed task. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Apply parent status checks at task-write boundaries.
Open an old task editor after archiving its parent. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The task operation returns the documented archived-parent result.
An old editor cannot silently reactivate the project.
Recovery evidence: Restore the parent and revisit all three tasks. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Restore the parent and revisit all three tasks.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does archiving preserve task history rather than delete it accidentally?
milestones.stretch: Add a read-only archived project view with deliberate restore controls.

milestones.title: Move tasks across projects
milestones.brief: Move task T-3 with evidence and dependencies from Alpha to Beta.
milestones.explanation: Moving a task must validate every relationship that assumes a shared project.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Move task T-3 with evidence and dependencies from Alpha to Beta. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Specify which evidence moves and which dependency edges block the command.
Attempt the move with a cross-project dependency present. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: A valid move preserves task identity and allowed history.
A blocked move changes neither parent link nor dependency edges.
Recovery evidence: Remove the blocking edge and retry the same request. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Remove the blocking edge and retry the same request.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Are derived counts updated for both source and destination?
milestones.stretch: Provide a move preview listing every affected relationship.

milestones.title: Distinguish clear from omit
milestones.brief: Edit a task whose deadline exists while sending a patch that omits the deadline key.
milestones.explanation: Omission preserves a field; explicit clearing removes it only when allowed.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Edit a task whose deadline exists while sending a patch that omits the deadline key. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Decode optional patch presence separately from nullable field values.
Send omitted, null, empty-string, and valid-date variants. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Omission preserves the deadline and explicit clear removes it.
Malformed empty-string dates never become accidental clears.
Recovery evidence: Submit the same patch through the API without the form. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Submit the same patch through the API without the form.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does a default value erase information about user intent?
milestones.stretch: Document patch examples in the service contract.

milestones.title: Restore a deleted task draft
milestones.brief: Delete a task in one tab while another contains a long unsaved description.
milestones.explanation: A missing entity response should preserve authored text without recreating identity automatically.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Delete a task in one tab while another contains a long unsaved description. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Show a copyable draft and explicit create-new action.
Save the stale editor and inspect database rows. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The original missing ID stays absent.
The draft remains available after the missing-task response.
Recovery evidence: Create a new task from the draft and reload. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Create a new task from the draft and reload.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Is create-new visibly distinct from retrying the stale update?
milestones.stretch: Offer a comparison when the task was archived instead of deleted.

milestones.title: Enforce title limits centrally
milestones.brief: Enter a whitespace-only title through a direct task command and a pasted long title through React.
milestones.explanation: All task entry paths need one normalization and length contract.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Enter a whitespace-only title through a direct task command and a pasted long title through React. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Reuse the operation decoder for create and rename.
Test boundary lengths after trimming, including line breaks. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Valid normalized titles persist identically through both paths.
Invalid titles cause zero repository mutations.
Recovery evidence: Make the UI validation intentionally permissive during the test. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Make the UI validation intentionally permissive during the test.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does repository code receive already validated domain values?
milestones.stretch: Add multiline-description limits independently from title limits.

milestones.title: Keep list counts truthful
milestones.brief: Create a task while a filtered project list refresh is still pending.
milestones.explanation: A stale list response must not overwrite a newer accepted task count.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Create a task while a filtered project list refresh is still pending. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Associate reads with request identity or derive counts from one reactive source.
Resolve the older list response after the create completes. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The displayed count includes the accepted new task.
The empty state never reappears from the obsolete read.
Recovery evidence: Fail the refresh after the successful create. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Fail the refresh after the successful create.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Can mutation confirmation and list loading coexist without contradiction?
milestones.stretch: Add a refresh timestamp for counts sourced from remote aggregation.

milestones.title: Require evidence before completion
milestones.brief: Attempt to complete task T-12 with no linked evidence record.
milestones.explanation: Completion is a domain transition whose preconditions must survive direct API calls.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Attempt to complete task T-12 with no linked evidence record. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Validate evidence presence within the completion operation.
Bypass the disabled button and execute the command directly. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: A task with valid evidence completes once.
A task without evidence stays open with an actionable error.
Recovery evidence: Delete evidence immediately before completion commits. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Delete evidence immediately before completion commits.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Are evidence checks and state mutation protected by one consistency boundary?
milestones.stretch: Support an explicitly audited waiver instead of weakening the default rule.

milestones.title: Validate evidence links safely
milestones.brief: Attach https evidence, a javascript URL, and an empty reference to one task.
milestones.explanation: A useful evidence reference needs an allowed representation and safe navigation behavior.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Attach https evidence, a javascript URL, and an empty reference to one task. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Decode allowed URL schemes and preserve plain-text notes separately.
Open accepted links and inspect the rendered anchor attributes. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Allowed references remain readable after reload.
Executable and malformed URLs never become active links.
Recovery evidence: Paste a URL containing credentials and inspect preview output. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Paste a URL containing credentials and inspect preview output.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does validation happen before any preview fetch or rendering?
milestones.stretch: Support repository-relative file references with an explicit resolver.

milestones.title: Keep evidence ownership intact
milestones.brief: Link evidence E-2 owned by project Beta to a task in project Alpha.
milestones.explanation: Knowing an evidence ID does not grant permission to attach or reveal it.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Link evidence E-2 owned by project Beta to a task in project Alpha. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Check task and evidence visibility in the same authenticated operation.
Attempt cross-project links as a viewer and an editor. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Authorized same-project evidence can be linked.
Unauthorized attempts reveal no private evidence title or content.
Recovery evidence: Revoke access after the picker loads but before submit. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Revoke access after the picker loads but before submit.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the backend trust picker filtering instead of authorizing the reference?
milestones.stretch: Add shared evidence with explicit access inheritance rules.

milestones.title: Reopen when proof changes
milestones.brief: Complete a task using evidence E-5, then remove that evidence.
milestones.explanation: The system must define whether completion remains historical or is invalidated by lost proof.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Complete a task using evidence E-5, then remove that evidence. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Choose and implement a removal policy with an audit event.
Remove the only evidence and inspect task status and history. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The result follows the published completion-evidence policy.
Evidence deletion cannot silently leave contradictory current-state claims.
Recovery evidence: Replace evidence while the task is completed. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Replace evidence while the task is completed.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does history distinguish original completion evidence from current attachments?
milestones.stretch: Version evidence so historical completion can reference an immutable snapshot.

milestones.title: Prevent duplicate evidence links
milestones.brief: Attach the same screenshot to a task twice through a slow form.
milestones.explanation: One logical attachment should produce one relationship under repeated delivery.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Attach the same screenshot to a task twice through a slow form. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Use a uniqueness rule for task ID and evidence identity.
Race repeated attach commands and inspect relationship rows. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Exactly one link exists with one visible attachment.
Duplicate delivery never inflates evidence counts.
Recovery evidence: Return a timeout after the first link commits and retry. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Return a timeout after the first link commits and retry.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the operation return the existing relation as a successful repeat?
milestones.stretch: Add explicit support for distinct annotated versions of the same source.

milestones.title: Separate observation from claim
milestones.brief: An agent writes a completion note saying tests passed without any recorded execution.
milestones.explanation: Evidence should identify what was actually observed and what remains an unverified claim.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: An agent writes a completion note saying tests passed without any recorded execution. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Add fields for command, result, environment, and artifact reference.
Complete a fixture using only a claim, then with a captured failing test. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The UI distinguishes observed failure from unsupported success language.
A failed test cannot be automatically labeled passing by note text.
Recovery evidence: Ask the agent to revise the implementation after the recorded failure. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Ask the agent to revise the implementation after the recorded failure.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Can a reviewer trace completion to concrete output rather than confidence wording?
milestones.stretch: Add a checklist requiring evidence for the task's specific acceptance criteria.

milestones.title: Retain evidence across reopen
milestones.brief: Complete, reopen, and complete the same task with a second test run.
milestones.explanation: Reopening changes workflow state while preserving prior evidence and decisions.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Complete, reopen, and complete the same task with a second test run. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Append transition events and associate evidence with each completion attempt.
Exercise two completion cycles and inspect chronological history. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Both runs and both completion events remain available.
Reopening does not erase the first attempt's diagnosis.
Recovery evidence: Fail the second completion after its evidence was saved. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Fail the second completion after its evidence was saved.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the model distinguish draft evidence from accepted completion evidence?
milestones.stretch: Show a comparison of evidence between consecutive completion attempts.

milestones.title: Make uploads independent of completion
milestones.brief: Upload proof successfully, then fail the task-completion write.
milestones.explanation: A completed upload and a completed task are separate durable facts.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Upload proof successfully, then fail the task-completion write. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Track attachment readiness and task transition status independently.
Inject failure only after attachment persistence succeeds. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The evidence remains linked and the task stays open.
Retrying completion does not upload a duplicate file.
Recovery evidence: Reload between the failed transition and its retry. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Reload between the failed transition and its retry.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the UI explain which part succeeded and which part needs retry?
milestones.stretch: Add cleanup for abandoned uploads without deleting evidence linked to active drafts.

milestones.title: Export meaningful completion evidence
milestones.brief: Export a completed task with a local note, remote link, and failed experiment.
milestones.explanation: An evidence export should preserve provenance and limitations outside the application.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Export a completed task with a local note, remote link, and failed experiment. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Include task identity, timestamps, criteria, observations, and link availability notes.
Read the exported Markdown in a plain-text viewer. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: All three evidence types retain their meaning and association.
The export never replaces a failed observation with a generic completed label.
Recovery evidence: Remove remote access and reread the exported record. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Remove remote access and reread the exported record.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does the artifact distinguish embedded content from external references?
milestones.stretch: Add a manifest for optional bundled artifacts with content hashes.

milestones.title: Complete task and update summary
milestones.brief: Complete one of three open tasks while the project stores a cached completion count.
milestones.explanation: The task state and its materialized count must commit together or be derived consistently.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Complete one of three open tasks while the project stores a cached completion count. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Update both records inside a transaction or remove redundant stored state.
Inject failure after task update but before count update. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: After failure, both records reflect the same precommand state.
No screen reports a completed task with the old cached total.
Recovery evidence: Retry after removing the failure and inspect the delta. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Retry after removing the failure and inspect the delta.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Is the count increment conditional on an actual state transition?
milestones.stretch: Rebuild cached counts from source tasks and compare results.

milestones.title: Delete a task with edges
milestones.brief: Delete a task referenced by two prerequisite edges and one evidence link.
milestones.explanation: Deletion needs a declared cascade-or-restrict policy for every related table.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Delete a task referenced by two prerequisite edges and one evidence link. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Enumerate dependent records and implement one atomic deletion command.
Fail the command after deleting one relationship. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: Either all permitted deletions commit or none do.
No dangling dependency or evidence relation survives unintentionally.
Recovery evidence: Retry while another operation adds a new dependency. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Retry while another operation adds a new dependency.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Are relationship constraints enforced at storage rather than only prechecked?
milestones.stretch: Add a dry-run deletion preview generated from the same dependency rules.

milestones.title: Move a task with summary counters
milestones.brief: Move a completed task from Alpha to Beta while both projects cache totals.
milestones.explanation: Source decrement, destination increment, and parent reassignment form one logical mutation.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Move a completed task from Alpha to Beta while both projects cache totals. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Perform all affected writes inside the repository's transaction scope.
Fail the destination counter update and inspect both projects. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The task and both counters retain their original consistent state.
A retry never decrements Alpha twice.
Recovery evidence: Deliver the same move command twice after a successful commit. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Deliver the same move command twice after a successful commit.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does idempotency cover the entire move rather than each write separately?
milestones.stretch: Include a move receipt that records source and destination revisions.

milestones.title: Keep network work outside transactions
milestones.brief: A completion command fetches a remote proof URL before writing local task state.
milestones.explanation: A database transaction should not be held open while waiting on unrelated network latency.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: A completion command fetches a remote proof URL before writing local task state. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Resolve external verification first, then revalidate required state in a short transaction.
Delay the remote response and issue another local task write. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The unrelated local write is not blocked for the network delay.
External verification cannot skip final revision validation.
Recovery evidence: Change the task while the remote proof request is pending. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Change the task while the remote proof request is pending.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Did the agent put an awaited HTTP request inside the database transaction?
milestones.stretch: Use expiring verification receipts that can be checked during the local commit.

milestones.title: Avoid caught transaction failures
milestones.brief: The second write in a completion transaction fails and a helper catches its error.
milestones.explanation: A swallowed failure can turn an intended rollback into a partial commit.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: The second write in a completion transaction fails and a helper catches its error. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Let transaction-critical failures propagate until the transaction boundary resolves.
Inject the failure and inspect task, evidence, and summary tables. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: The operation reports failure and every provisional change rolls back.
A convenience catch never returns a fake success inside the transaction.
Recovery evidence: Add logging and repeat to ensure logging does not consume the error. Record the resulting state and prove that a fresh valid action still works.

milestones.experiment: Add logging and repeat to ensure logging does not consume the error.
milestones.review: Review the agent's proposed diff: Does each catch explicitly preserve the rollback semantics?
milestones.stretch: Represent optional postcommit diagnostics separately from mandatory writes.

milestones.title: Validate batch reassignment atomically
milestones.brief: Reassign six tasks to a milestone when one task belongs to another project.
milestones.explanation: A batch relationship change should validate every target before committing any target.
steps: Create a repeatable fixture: Reassign six tasks to a milestone when one task belongs to another project. Record the starting rows and relevant UI state before making the change.
Resolve and validate the entire selected set within the chosen transaction policy.
Include the foreign-project task as the last item. Exercise the real operation boundary as well as the rendered result.

checks.label: An atomic policy leaves all six tasks unchanged.
